about: 20 varied synthetic cases for end-to-end checks against a running backend with the real model. Fictional people and plates. Dates are relative to 8 Oct 2026: 'in time' cases are recent, 'late NTK' cases are late for Schedule 4 but still inside the 28-day appeal period. Each case: notice text, customer account, answers keyed by a regex on the question text, and what a correct result must contain.
